title: The Skate in the Crease
setup: Game 6 of the 1999 Stanley Cup Final, Dallas against Buffalo, deep in triple overtime. Brett Hull fires a rebound past goaltender Dominik Hasek. Replays show his skate was in the goal crease when he shot.
question: Does the goal count?
options: No goal. A skate in the crease cancels it.
Goal. A skate in the crease was allowed when the shooter had control of the puck.
The league decides in a vote after the game.
ruling: The goal counted. Earlier that season the NHL had circulated a clarification to teams saying a skate could be in the crease if the player was in control of the puck.
rulebookNote: Many fans never saw the clarification, which is why the goal stayed controversial.
